prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 常用化学试剂清单 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "名称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "分子式" · longest unbreakable word 135px · one-line width 135px
  col 3: header "CAS 号" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 78px
  col 4: header "纯度" · longest unbreakable word 54px · one-line width 135px
  col 5: header "储存条件（长）" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 1145px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"供读者识别常用化学试剂，并查阅其纯度和储存要求。","reading":"读者先按名称定位试剂，再横向核对分子式、CAS 号和纯度，最后阅读储存条件；储存说明较长，通常决定行高。","groups":["名称、分子式和 CAS 号共同用于识别试剂，其中后两列是需要准确核对的标识。","纯度和储存条件描述试剂规格与保管要求，需与同一行的试剂保持清晰对应。"],"keep_intact":["分子式及其下标、结晶水记法","CAS 号","纯度百分比和范围","名称尽量完整，尤其是较长的乙二胺四乙酸二钠"],"may_wrap":["储存条件可在自然语义位置换行，其产生的行高也可容纳同一行其他单元格的换行。","纯度等级与百分比之间可以换行。","空间紧张时，较长的中文试剂名称可以换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [115, 156, 99, 100, 249] · table 720×1082px · row heights [36, 153, 153, 153, 153, 129, 153, 153] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [144, 156, 99, 96, 224] · table 720×1082px · row heights [36, 153, 153, 153, 153, 129, 153, 153] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [100, 156, 99, 90, 274] · table 720×919px · row heights [36, 129, 129, 129, 129, 106, 129, 129] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"分子式和 CAS 号完整，纯度范围保持在同一行；各行边界清楚，长名称虽换行仍可识别。","problems":"储存说明密集且多处达到六行，识别列下方留下大片空白；长名称被拆成两行。","cause":"储存列为249px，正文空间不足；名称列为115px，容不下最长名称。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"所有名称完整显示，分子式、CAS 号和纯度范围也便于核对。","problems":"储存说明列显得局促，换行频繁，部分温度数值与单位分离；宽名称列在多数行留下较多空白。","cause":"名称列增至144px，储存列缩至224px；纯度列96px仍足以容纳百分比范围。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"储存说明有更舒适的阅读宽度，行高和表格整体长度均有所改善；分子式与 CAS 号完整。","problems":"两处纯度范围被拆成多行，削弱数值比较；最长名称也被拆行。","cause":"储存列增至274px，但纯度列只有90px，名称列只有100px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"C-purity","widths":[100,156,99,96,268],"change":"以 r1C 为基础，将纯度列加宽至96px，尝试保持百分比范围完整；从储存列借出6px，保留其主要宽度优势。"},{"name":"balanced-name","widths":[115,156,99,96,253],"change":"加宽名称列，改善较长名称的断行，同时保持纯度范围完整；储存列仍略宽于 r1A，检验名称与说明之间的折中。"},{"name":"full-name","widths":[144,156,99,96,224],"change":"名称完整的一行布局已由 r1B 覆盖，因此改用更紧凑的名称宽度作为替代方案。"}]}
